privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Baraka collects the minimum data necessary to provide the service: email, name, language, location (during use, to display nearby bags) and order history.
privacy.useBody: Your data is used to log you in, show you nearby bags, manage your reservations and send you pickup notifications. It is neither sold nor transferred to third parties.
privacy.paymentBody: Online payments are processed by our provider (Konnect). Baraka never stores card numbers.
privacy.rightsBody: You can view, correct or delete your data at any time from the app (Profile → Delete my account) or by writing to privacy@baraka.tn.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Use
terms.intro: Baraka connects merchants offering their unsold food as surprise bags with customers who wish to collect them at a reduced price.
terms.reservationsBody: A reservation constitutes a commitment to collect the bag during the indicated time slot. The exact contents of the bag are a surprise. Cancellations are possible up to 2 hours before the time slot.
terms.paymentBody: Payment is made at pickup (cash) or online. If the merchant cancels, any online payment is refunded in full.
terms.liabilityBody: Merchants are responsible for the quality and food safety of the bags. Baraka acts as a technical intermediary.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your Baraka account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your account and all your data at any time.
deleteAccount.afterBody: Deletion is immediate and permanent: your profile, your orders and your devices are erased. Certain billing data may be retained for the legally required period.
deleteAccount.withoutAppBody: Write to privacy@baraka.tn from the email address associated with your account; we process the request within 30 days.
